reviews.text:
I recently tried the Unleashia Glitterpedia eyeshadow palette (All of Dancing Swan), and it is absolutely beautiful! Although the pan size and product volume are on the smaller side, the quality is incredible.
My absolute favorites in this palette are the blue and pink shades, but the blue one is definitely my number one. The shadows are super easy to apply and they stay on perfectly throughout the day with zero fallout. Most of the glitter particles are quite fine and delicate, but the blue shade features slightly larger glitters that catch the light beautifully. They do an amazing job of creating a gorgeous, wet-looking shimmering effect on the eyes. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
我最近試咗 Unleashia Glitterpedia 眼影盤（All of Dancing Swan），真係好靚！雖然每格眼影大小同產品份量都比較細，但質素真係好出色。
呢盤入面我最愛嘅係藍色同粉紅色，不過藍色絕對係我嘅第一位。眼影好容易上妝，全日都可以完美留喺眼上，冇掉粉。大部分閃粉都好細好精緻，不過藍色嗰款閃粉稍為大啲，反光效果好漂亮。佢哋可以喺眼上營造出一種好靚、好似濕潤嘅閃亮效果。極力推薦！

reviews.text:
The palette already looked super pretty in promo pics. But it doesn't do justice to how pretty this looks in person. 😍😍😍 Unleashia nailed the "I'm cold" makeup concept the balance in the color story is really outstanding! 👌👌👌

Personally, as a big eyeshadow palette collector, I don't think I have anything like this, is very unique and even though the majority of the shadows are glitters, they do show up well in terms of color, you can create a soft frosty eye look or something more dramatic and elegant for a special night out. 🥳🥳🥳👌That versatility is something I really look for in a palette.

I'm really happy with this particular purchase, the winter is not over yet. Hehe. Highly recommend if you wish to get out of your comfort zone, same old nude palette, want to experiment safely with color and get an eye look with an elegant, excentric touch.
reviews.zh:
呢盤喺宣傳相入面已經好靚，但係真人睇落，都比唔上佢嘅靚。😍😍😍 Unleashia 完美演繹咗「I'm cold」嘅妝容概念，色彩配搭真係非常出色！👌👌👌

我個人係眼影盤嘅大收藏家，我諗我冇任何類似嘅嘢，好獨特，雖然大部分眼影都係閃粉，但係顏色上都好出位。你可以化出柔和嘅霜感眼妝，或者係特別嘅夜晚化一啲更加有戲劇性同優雅嘅眼妝。🥳🥳🥳👌呢種百搭性正正係我喺眼影盤上好睇重嘅。

我對今次購買非常滿意，冬天仲未完呢。哈哈。如果你想跳出舒適圈，唔想再用舊式嘅大地色眼影盤，想安全咁試吓顏色，同埋想搵到一款優雅又帶少少獨特感覺嘅眼妝，我非常推薦。

reviews.text: this is such a pretty pallete omg. there’s no fallout and the glitter stays on my eyelids. it’s perfectttt. there’s chunky glitters and finer glitters and both are so prettyuruu!!,!;!,!!! this pallete is also really good to highlight aegyosal!! b. only thing is the colors aren’t as pink as in the product photo as they are when i received them… other than that it is 10/10
reviews.zh:
呢盤真係好靚呀！冇掉粉，閃粉牢牢咁留喺眼皮上。完美！！有粗閃粉同細閃粉，兩種都好靚！！呢盤仲好適合用嚟提亮淚袋！！！
唯一問題係，收到嘅顏色冇產品圖咁粉紅……除咗呢點之外，我俾 10 分。

reviews.text:
Pros 👍: Pigmented enough for someone on the fairer side like me, so much glitter in each pigment, beautiful colors that can suit anyone. The pigments are different levels of butteryness and are not so rough so applying them on is nice and smooth

Slight Cons 👎: there could be more variety of colors like purple, red or blue etc
reviews.zh:
優點 👍：對我呢類膚色較淺嘅人嚟講，上色力都夠，每款色粉都有好多閃粉，顏色好靚，幾乎啱所有人用。色粉嘅油潤度唔同，而且唔會好粗糙，所以上色好順滑。

輕微缺點 👎：可以有多啲顏色，例如紫色、紅色或者藍色等。

reviews.text: One photo is unfocused and blurry so you can see emphasized sparkles and shimmers. Surprisingly versatile palette! Multiple different finishes and textures. Glitter sticks easily on top of the lid and doesn't move throughout the day, matte shadows are buildable but not overly pigmented. Pretty easy to work with, no matter what texture is used. Really enjoying this lately as my everyday palette!
reviews.zh: 有一張相對焦唔準、有啲模糊，咁樣你就可以睇到閃粉同亮片更突出。令人意外嘅係呢個眼影盤好百搭！有多種唔同嘅質感同質地。閃粉容易貼喺眼皮上，全日都唔會移位；霧面眼影可以逐層疊加，但唔會太濃色。不論用邊種質地，都好易上妝。最近用嚟做我嘅日常眼影盤，好享受！

reviews.text: the swatches might look a little bit sheer, but trust me when i say they are super duper buildable (only one swipe in my swatches)! MOST GORGEOUS GLITTERS TO EVER EXIST AND THEYRE SUPER BUTTERY SMOOTH!!???! some of the best glitter toppers I've ever used and there's a huge variety in just one palette too! and because the eyeshadow is sheer but buildable, u can do natural everyday makeup, but also super heavy glam!!! anyways go buy it rn if u were being indecisive u wont regret I promiseee <3
reviews.zh: 色卡可能睇落有啲通透，但你要相信我，佢哋真係超好疊色（我嘅色卡只係掃咗一下）！最美嘅閃粉，質地超級順滑！？！我試過最好嘅閃粉面層之一，而且就一盤入面已經有好多款式！因為眼影通透但可以疊深，所以你可以化日常自然妝，都可以化超濃嘅華麗妝！！！總之而家就快啲去買啦，如果你一直猶豫，我保證你唔會後悔 <3

reviews.text: I love how the palette included multiple different finishes and textures. I also love how all of the chunky ones have a bit of base to them to allow them to stick without having a bunch of fallout on my face. Overall I think it's really versatile in uses, some as toppers, some as all over. Overall I really recommend!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個盤包含咗多種唔同嘅質感同質地。我亦都好鍾意所有粗粒嘅色粉都有少少底，可以貼住，唔會好多粉屑跌落面上。整體嚟講，我覺得用途好多元化，有啲用嚟疊色，有啲用嚟全面上色。總括嚟講，我真心推薦！

reviews.text: i love this palette, it has got soft matte shades and wonderful sparkly ones. the sparkle is gorgeous, fine and easy to apply. There are 2 glitter shades, a bit similar to colourpop pressed glitter but imo these ones are prettier. I love pat mcgrath special shimmer shades and I think that the shimmers in this palette can be an excellent replacement, especially if you pack them on. I am leaning towards buying another one of these palettes.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢盤，有柔和嘅霧面色，同埋漂亮嘅閃亮色。閃粉好靚、幼細，容易上妝。有兩款閃粉，有啲似 ColourPop 壓製閃粉，但我覺得呢啲更加靚。我好鍾意 Pat McGrath 嘅特別閃亮眼影，我覺得呢盤嘅閃粉可以係一個好好嘅替代品，特別係如果你厚厚咁疊。我而家好傾向再買一盤呢款。
